import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartRange

/-! Reviewer probe r7b, testing ajcr-p2's parameter-matching claim (I-1345).

My join probe used ONE parameter `g` on both sides. p2 says the parameter where
COVERAGE is available and the one where `rep` is supplied DIFFER at positive
genus. Question: does `mixedParamChart` FORCE the two to agree at each index? -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
universe u

-- `hdeg i` couples m i, nn i and the theta class degree. If a coverage lane can
-- only work at parameter `p` while rep is supplied at `q`, we need nn i = q AND
-- the chart usable where coverage lives. Test: is nn i free of any constraint
-- tying it to a second parameter?
noncomputable example {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    {ι : Type u} (nn : ι → ℕ) (D : ι → Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (rep : ∀ i, (divFunctor C pi (nn i)).RepresentableBy (D i))
    (m : ι → ℕ) (Z : ι → (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (Z i)
      = (m i : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (nn i : ℤ))
    (V : ∀ i, (D i).left.Opens) (i : ι) :
    -- the chart exists at index i with NO second parameter mentioned
    yoneda.obj ((V i : Scheme.{u})) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
  mixedParamChart C pi nn D rep m Z hdeg V i

end AlgebraicGeometry
